# Field blocks for Saarland, Germany

Germany, Saarland (LPIS) field boundaries (2026) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Ministerium für Umwelt, Klima, Mobilität, Agrar und Verbraucherschutz. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sl_block/latest/de_sl_block.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sl_block/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:4258; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: id, crop:name, crop:name_en, geometry, flik, metrics:area, crop:code, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sl_block/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sl_block/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/de_sl_block/collection.json
